title: Metagenomic analysis of nitrifying microbial communities in a down-flow hanging sponge reactor
description: The project investigated the microbial community structure to assess nitrogen transformation potential in a down-flow hanging sponge reactor treating synthetic wastewater under oxygen-limited condition. Metagenomic sequencing focused on comammox bacteria and associated nitrifying microorganisms.
samples: Metagenome or environmental sample from biofilm metagenome
